Name: Yuki Nakamura

Work Experience:
- 2023--2023: Research Intern, Condensed Matter Physics, RIKEN. Assisted in experimental setup for quantum material analysis using cryogenic equipment. Collected and processed data from magnetoresistance measurements under the supervision of senior researchers. Developed Python scripts to automate data visualization and preliminary analysis. Participated in weekly group meetings, presenting findings and discussing methodological improvements. Contributed to lab maintenance and safety protocol documentation.
- 2022--2022: Summer Intern, Computational Physics, The University of Tokyo, Department of Physics. Implemented Monte Carlo simulations to model electron behavior in lattice structures. Collaborated with graduate students to optimize simulation parameters for improved accuracy. Prepared detailed reports summarizing simulation outcomes and potentia
